name: ComfyUI
description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
one_liner: A visual, drag-and-drop workbench for building custom AI image and video generation pipelines, without writing code.
buyer: A creative agency or indie game studio that wants an in-house AI art pipeline instead of paying per-image fees to a tool like Midjourney.
business_use_cases: A game studio builds a custom pipeline to mass-produce concept art and texture variations in-house instead of outsourcing every iteration to artists.
A marketing agency builds a repeatable node pipeline for a client's product photography style and reuses it across every new product listing.
A print-on-demand shop wires up a pipeline that automatically generates on-brand artwork variations for each new product it adds to the store.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell custom ComfyUI workflow templates for specific niches, such as product photography or game concept art, on creator marketplaces.
Offer a managed, hosted ComfyUI service with pre-built workflows so non-technical creatives don't need to set up their own GPUs.

steal_this: Build one repeatable workflow for a style you use often, like product shots, this weekend, and sell access to run it as a service for a niche of small sellers.
